description: A pew that does not turn

participation.context: Sat beside her and went up to the table.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Preached on the light and was not brief.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

participation.context: Kept him in the pew and named the owl.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Sat three rows ahead and did not speak.
participation.name: Sir John Spencer

story.body: You sat the sermon, went away to the owl for a minute, and came back for the bread. The Mayor did not turn.

title: Sat the Candlemas sermon and went to the owl for a minute

participation.context: Ate, refused the errand, and left the letter unwritten until after dinner.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Laid the loaf to the notch and priced the meat at threepence.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Named the finger, and offered to carry the letter.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Took the heel and did not hurry the post.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

story.body: You sat down to the finger-short penny loaf, said the twins were ten, and would not send Alse to the Bell a day early. The meat was threepence. You did not buy another loaf.

title: Ate the short loaf and kept the letter for Thursday
